sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety in one unified table; GRSD was selected after current-corpus duplicate checks.
Read official arXiv abstract and HTML full text; extracted method, benchmarks, formulas, ablations, hyperparameters, evidence limits, and safety implications.
Reviewed verifier dependence, reflection fidelity, negative controls, rollout cost, and unsafe shortcut distillation risks.
Article uses structured Chinese Markdown with tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, and a measured 5688 CJK characters.
